source.description: One reviewed six-panel felt-tip marker contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one face-free hot-air balloon with one scalloped envelope, four vertical panel seams, one narrow neck, two suspension ropes, two small burner shapes, one rectangular basket, three cloud wisps, and no text or logos.

process_strategy: Reserve the envelope, four seams, neck, ropes, burners, basket, highlights, and clouds in pale construction; wrap those same footprints with bold handmade contours; preserve every count through the marker passes; and limit the final panel to outline, fill, highlight, and edge cleanup.

final_elements.name: scalloped balloon envelope narrow neck and rectangular basket contours
final_elements.description: A stable face-free hot-air balloon silhouette with a gently scalloped envelope, small neck opening, and woven rectangular basket.

final_elements.description: Exactly four curved vertical seams, two ropes, two burner shapes, two open-paper highlights, and three separate cloud wisps.

final_elements.name: thick black felt-tip outline and basket weave hatching
final_elements.description: Handmade black marker reinforces every established contour and adds short cross-hatching inside the already established basket.

final_elements.name: raspberry mustard teal cobalt and warm-brown marker fills
final_elements.description: Alternating saturated balloon bands, a warm-brown basket, small mustard burners, and pale cobalt cloud accents with visible marker streaks.

rejection_checks: Keep one face-free balloon, one upright flight pose, one crop, and one scale in all six panels.
Keep exactly four envelope seams, two suspension ropes, two burners, two highlights, one basket, and three cloud wisps after those routes appear.
No seam may cross a reserved highlight gap, no rope may pass through the basket rim, and no cloud line may cross the balloon silhouette.
Do not add people, faces, flags, lettering, numbers, logos, brand marks, birds, a second balloon, sticker borders, badge frames, arrows, signatures, or watermarks.
The final panel may not introduce a seam, rope, burner, basket edge, cloud, highlight, hatch cluster, or color area.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and imperfect handmade edges rather than vector-clean travel art, polished AI poster rendering, or glossy icon art.
